label: Swoop Ahead
description: Warns you about 250 m before a magpie swooping spot, with a banner and three rising beeps. Tap the Magpie field to mark a swoop where you are. Marks go to a shared map so other riders are warned too, with no account. The map is at swoopahead.pages.dev.
releaseNotes: A mark can now be cancelled: tap the Magpie field again within 15 seconds and nothing is sent. Remove my last mark also takes a mark off the shared map for up to a day.
